```{r}
#| label: functions
calculate_doses <- function(data) {
  df |>
    group_by(jurisdiction, vaccine, week) |>
    summarize(
      total_doses = sum(first_dose, second_dose, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_doses <- function(data, name, months) {
  data |>
    calculate_doses() |>
    filter(month(week) %in% month) |>
    ggplot(aes(week, total_doses, color = vaccine)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = name)
}
```
